programs.name: Residential Grass Removal Incentive
programs.statusNote: The city's page does not state current funding status. Applications are reviewed as funds allow; confirm before you start.
eligibility: You own the home (landlords may apply for rental properties).
You are a Phoenix Water Services customer.
The grass is alive and healthy at 75% density or more (bare soil and weeds under 25%).
prohibitions: Do not remove any grass before you receive the Notice to Proceed.
No water features or pools in the removal area.
No bare soil after the project.
Grass cannot be reinstalled while you own the property.
requirements: Describe what will replace the grass; desert landscaping is recommended.
Plants in the right-of-way must come from the Low-Water-Use/Drought-Tolerant plant list.
Follow your HOA rules and Maricopa County Rule 310.01.
documents: Aerial image showing the square footage
Two photos of the grass before removal
Affidavit of Lawful Presence with a copy of your ID
After completion: at least two photos and a copy of the NTP
programs.howToApply: Online through the myPHX311 portal only (no mail or email).
programs.payment: Check mailed after final approval, typically within 1 to 2 billing cycles.

programs.name: Residential Grass-to-Xeriscape and Tree Bonus Incentive
programs.statusNote: Funding is limited and first-come, first-served. Confirm availability with Mesa Water Conservation before you start.
eligibility: You currently own a single-family home and are a Mesa water customer.
About 70% healthy grass coverage (bare soil and weeds under 30% of the area).
Grass is not well- or flood-irrigated.
The home was not built within the past year.
One incentive per property every 3 years; only future projects qualify.
prohibitions: Do not remove grass until Mesa inspects and approves.
Artificial turf or rock alone does not count.
No spray irrigation and no black plastic sheeting.
Concrete may cover no more than 25% of the area.
requirements: Plants must reach at least 50% canopy coverage at maturity, from the ADWR low-water-use list.
Tree bonus: new low-water trees, at least 1 gallon, planted in the ground after approval (not citrus, ash or ficus).
programs.howToApply: Apply to Mesa's Environmental and Sustainability Department before starting. Questions: 480-644-3306 or conservation.info@mesaaz.gov.
programs.payment: Paid after completion and final approval.

programs.name: Residential Grass Removal Rebate
programs.statusNote: Rebates are first come, first served and depend on available funds. Confirm with the Water Conservation Office before you start.
programs.minimumWaiver: The minimum may be waived if all remaining grass on the property is removed.

approval.name: Notice to Proceed (NtP)
approval.reviewTime: Staff verify the measurement, which may include an on-site inspection
approval.completeWithin: 90 days after the NtP unless the Water Conservation Office approves otherwise

eligibility: You own the property and have an active Chandler water utility account.
The grass is living and regularly irrigated.
Flood-irrigated areas and new construction are not eligible.
Work completed before January 1, 2026 is not eligible.
prohibitions: Do not remove or overseed grass before the review is complete.
No artificial turf, black plastic sheeting, fountains or pools in the rebate area.
No bare soil in conversion areas.
requirements: Plants from the Phoenix AMA Low-Water-Use/Drought-Tolerant Plant List, purchased from a nursery.
At least 50% canopy coverage of the landscapable area.
At least 50% of the total landscapable area must be non-grass after conversion.
Granite top dressing at least 2 inches deep.
documents: Pre-Grass-Removal Notice to Proceed Application with at least two before photos
After completion: Grass Removal Application with at least two photos of the finished landscape
programs.howToApply: Submit the Pre-Grass-Removal NtP application; questions: conserve@chandleraz.gov or 480-782-3580.
programs.payment: Credit to your utility account after final inspection.

programs.name: Residential Grass Removal Rebate
programs.statusNote: The program closed on Oct. 31, 2025, and is set to return with a new rebate season. Requirements are under review.
eligibility: You receive water service from Scottsdale Water.
Removal already in progress or finished is not eligible.
prohibitions: Do not begin removal until the program reopens and you receive a Notice to Proceed.
programs.howToApply: Watch the city's residential rebates page or sign up for early notification of the 2026 launch.
